faqs.a:
(a)
It is unlawful for any person to operate a massage parlor within this city unless
               such person shall have first obtained a massage parlor license from the city.
(b)
Such license shall be prominently displayed at all times upon the premises for which
               the license was issued.
(Code 1981, § 16-5; Ord. No. 3292, § 1, 10-21-1996)
